stem.text: The diagram shows a motorised vehicle for carrying one person.

stem.alt: Diagram of a person standing on a platform beside a wheel on an axle, holding a handle. Labels: axle, 400 mm, 600 N (two downward arrows), and direction of motion (arrow pointing right).

stem.text: The vehicle has two wheels on one axle. The passenger stands on a platform between the wheels.
The weight of the machine is $600\,\text{N}$. Its centre of mass is $200\,\text{mm}$ in front of the axle. The wheel radius is $400\,\text{mm}$.
When stationary, a passenger of weight $600\,\text{N}$ stands with his centre of mass $200\,\text{mm}$ behind the axle to balance the machine.
The motor is now switched on to provide a horizontal force of $90\,\text{N}$ at the ground to move the vehicle forwards.
How far and in which direction must the passenger move his centre of mass to maintain balance?
